CXL: Dual-zone automatic climate control (replaces single-zone on CX)
Heated driver and front passenger seats
All-wheel drive with electronic limited-slip rear differential available
Auto-dimming inside rearview mirror and Universal Home Remote
Bluetooth phone connectivity and Harman Kardon 11-speaker audio available
CXS: 3.6L VVT direct-injection V6 (replaces 3.0L V6 on CX and CXL)
Magnetic variable-effort rack-and-pinion steering (replaces standard power steering on CX)
Dual stainless exhaust with bright tips; real-time adaptive suspension available
